scope: Gemini 3.1 Live (AI Studio) vs OpenAI gpt-realtime-2.1. 2.5 and the mini are dropped: 2.5 lost its only advantage when BAA became unaffordable, and the mini degrades to 2,748 ms by turn 5 and drops ~12% of turns.
